entities.name: Phoenon
entities.description: Oldest of the eight Thran city-states, mountain-locked, on the Pilgrim's Way to Halcyon.

entities.name: Pilgrim's Way
entities.description: Road through Phoenon leading to Halcyon.

entities.name: Halcyon
entities.description: Capital city of the Thran Empire.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Judged by the Elder Council; bombed Phoenon after it fell to the Thran Alliance.

entities.name: Thran-Phyrexian War
entities.description: War in which Phoenon changed sides.

events.summary: Phoenon stays on Yawgmoth's side while he is judged by the Elder Council.
Phoenon falls to the Thran Alliance early in the Thran-Phyrexian War, and Yawgmoth retaliates with airship bombing.
events.quote: Yagwmoth retaliated by sending his airships there and bombing both the enemy's airborne armada and the city itself.

relations.quote: Phoenon was one of the eight city-states of the Thran Empire .
